questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'Docile'.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Pliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Docile"** means ready to accept control or instruction, submissive, or easy to teach or manage. (आज्ञाकारी या विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The docile puppy obeyed every command from its owner.
 
 
• **"Pliable"** refers to something that is easily bent or flexible, but when used to describe a person, it means someone who is easily influenced or controlled. (लचीला या आसानी से प्रभावित होने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The young boy had a pliable mind, open to new ideas and teachings.
 
 
• Hence, "Pliable" is the correct synonym for "Docile."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reveal** (प्रकट करना): To make known or disclose something that was hidden or unknown.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician finally revealed the secret behind his trick.
 
 
 
• **Exhibit** (प्रदर्शित करना): To display or show something publicly.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist decided to exhibit her paintings at the local gallery.
 
 
 
• **Clarify** (स्पष्ट करना): To make something clear or easier to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher clarified the complex concept with a simple example.

questions.question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"The study of growing fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants."
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Horticulture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Horticulture"** refers to the branch of agriculture that focuses on the cultivation of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and ornamental plants. (बागवानी)
 
 
• **Example:** She studied horticulture at the university to learn modern techniques for growing organic vegetables.
 
 
• **"Floriculture"** is a subset of horticulture that specifically deals with the cultivation of flowering and ornamental plants for decorative purposes. (फूलों की खेती)
 
 
• **Example:** The farmer shifted to floriculture to cater to the increasing demand for cut flowers in the market.
 
 
• Hence, the term "Horticulture" accurately describes the study and practice of growing fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Horticulture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Floriculture** (फूलों की खेती): The cultivation and management of flowering and ornamental plants.
 
 
• **Example:** Floriculture has become a profitable business for many farmers in recent years.
 
 
• **Agronomy** (कृषि विज्ञान): The science of soil management and the production of field crops.
 
 
• **Example:** His research in agronomy led to the development of high-yielding crop varieties.
 
 
• **Botany** (वनस्पति विज्ञान): The scientific study of plants, including their physiology, structure, genetics, and ecology.
 
 
• **Example:** The botany professor explained the process of photosynthesis in detail during the lecture.

questions.question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The engineer is testing the system to ensure its reliability under stress.

options.text: The system is tested by the engineer to ensure reliability.
The system is being tested by the engineer to ensure its reliability under stress.
The system has been tested by the engineer.
The engineer had tested the system already.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The engineer is testing the system to ensure its reliability under stress."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the system" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is testing" to "is being tested" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the engineer."
 
• Ensure the remaining part of the sentence "to ensure its reliability under stress" remains unchanged for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The system is being tested by the engineer to ensure its reliability under stress."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The system is tested by the engineer to ensure reliability." – Incorrect as it uses the simple present instead of the present continuous tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"The system has been tested by the engineer." – Incorrect as it uses the present perfect tense instead of the present continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"The engineer had tested the system already." – Incorrect as it is in the past perfect tense and does not follow the passive structure.
</ul

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

Mohan said, "I saw him yesterday."

options.text: Mohan said that he saw him yesterday.
Mohan said that he had seen him the previous day.
Mohan said that he see him yesterday.
Mohan said that he had saw him yesterday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Mohan said that he had seen him the previous day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I saw" becomes "he had seen"**
 
 
• The past simple tense ("saw") in direct speech changes to past perfect tense ("had seen") in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to reflect the subject of the reporting clause.
 
 
 
• **"yesterday" becomes "the previous day"**
 
 
• Time expressions such as "yesterday" are changed in indirect speech to maintain the correct time reference.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a reported clause using the conjunction "that."
 
• The sentence is structured in accordance with the rules of indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mohan said that he had seen him the previous day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Mohan said that he saw him yesterday."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "saw" should change to "had seen" in indirect speech.
 
• Time expression "yesterday" is not converted to "the previous day."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Mohan said that he see him yesterday."
 
 
• Incorrect verb form: "see" is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Mohan said that he had saw him yesterday."
 
 
• Incorrect verb usage: "had saw" is grammatically incorrect; it should be "had seen."
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

Rita said that she could not attend the meeting because she was unwell.

options.text: Rita said, "I cannot attend the meeting because I am unwell."
Rita said, "I will not attend the meeting because I was unwell."
Rita said, "I could not attend the meeting because I was unwell."
Rita said, "She could not attend the meeting because she was unwell."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rita said that she could not attend the meeting because she was unwell.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she could not attend" becomes "I could not attend"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "could" remains unchanged as it retains the past tense.
 
 
 
• **"because she was unwell" remains "because I was unwell"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is converted to "I" for direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "said"
 
• Remains "said" in direct speech, as there is no change in tone or context.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a full stop ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I could not attend the meeting because I was unwell,” said Rita."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I cannot attend the meeting because I am unwell," said Rita."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "cannot" and "am unwell" change the meaning from past inability to present inability.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "I will not attend the meeting because I was unwell," said Rita."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "will not attend" changes the meaning to a future decision rather than a past event.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She could not attend the meeting because she was unwell," said Rita."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "she" does not match the direct speech format where Rita speaks about herself.
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace.

2. Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge.

3. As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before.

4. Technology has revolutionized education.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins with **Sentence 4**, which introduces the central idea that technology has revolutionized education. 
 
• **Sentence 2 comes next**, as it elaborates on the impact of technology by highlighting the accessibility of global knowledge through online platforms: 
 
 
• "Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 follows**, building on the benefits of online platforms by emphasizing flexibility in learning: 
 
 
• "They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 concludes** the paragraph by summarizing the broader implications of these advancements: 
 
 
• "As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before." 
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **4-2-1-3**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Technology has revolutionized education. Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge. They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace. As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before."</div

questions.question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. Traits such as eye color, blood type, and susceptibility to certain diseases are passed on by the process of replication.

2. The specific sequence of bases in a gene determines the structure of a protein, and therefore its function.

3. DNA is organized into structures called genes, which carry instructions for building proteins.

4. This is the foundation of heredity, as offspring inherit a combination of genes from their parents, which influence their traits.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence begins with Sentence 3, which introduces DNA and its organization into genes, setting the foundation.
 
• **Sentence 2 follows**, as it describes how the sequence of bases in a gene determines protein structure and function:
 
 
• "The specific sequence of bases in a gene determines the structure of a protein, and therefore its function."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 comes next**, explaining how genes are inherited and their role in heredity:
 
 
• "This is the foundation of heredity, as offspring inherit a combination of genes from their parents, which influence their traits."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 concludes** the paragraph by highlighting the traits passed down through replication:
 
 
• "Traits such as eye color, blood type, and susceptibility to certain diseases are passed on by the process of replication."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **3-2-4-1**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"DNA is organized into structures called genes, which carry instructions for building proteins. The specific sequence of bases in a gene determines the structure of a protein, and therefore its function. This is the foundation of heredity, as offspring inherit a combination of genes from their parents, which influence their traits. Traits such as eye color, blood type, and susceptibility to certain diseases are passed on by the process of replication."</div

questions.question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

He said, "Have you brought your original marksheets here with you?"

options.text: He asked me if I have taken my original marksheets here with me.
He asked me if I took my original marksheets there with me.
He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me.
He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with them.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Have you brought" becomes "if I had taken"**
 
 
• Reporting verb "said" changes to "asked" to match the question format.
 
• Verb "have brought" is converted to "had taken" to reflect the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"your original marksheets here" becomes "my original marksheets there"**
 
 
• Pronoun "your" is changed to "my" to match the perspective of the speaker.
 
• Adverb "here" is changed to "there" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted to a statement without quotation marks.
 
• Question form is retained indirectly with "if".
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He asked me if I have taken my original marksheets here with me." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have taken" should be changed to "had taken" in indirect speech.
 
• Incorrect adverb: "here" should be changed to "there."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He asked me if I took my original marksheets there with me." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "took" does not correctly reflect the original question format.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked me if I had taken my original marksheets there with them." 
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "them" does not match the original sentence context.
 
 
</ul
